text: Rocky, Alex and Money break into Detroit houses for a living, and Rocky dreams of escaping to California with her younger sister. [A tip about $300,000 in cash|trigger|need and greed] leads them to the house of Norman Nordstrom, a blind Gulf War veteran alone in an abandoned neighborhood. Once inside, the old man kills Money and [hunts the others through the darkened house|rules|how it hunts], and in the basement they find a restrained pregnant woman, kept as [a replacement for the daughter he lost|wants|getting back the lost].
